Ludwig Wittgenstein

Quotes / Ludwig Wittgenstein / Q0125

English

The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.
Thinker Ludwig Wittgenstein
School Analytic Philosophy
Source Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus 5.6
Theme Language
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus 5.6, within the tradition of Analytic Philosophy. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of language, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Ludwig Wittgenstein's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
